title: Mapping one encoded chunk
statement: Given a function $g$ from Boolean words to Boolean words and a Boolean word $S$, return the empty word if the second component of $S$ is empty. Otherwise, pair-encode the result of applying $g$ to the pair encoding of the first component of $S$ and the first component of its second component, with the empty word.
